newsitem.title: THAILAND: Two killed, one missing in south Thailand flood.
newsitem.headline: Two killed, one missing in south Thailand flood.

text.p: Two people were killed and a boy was missing after flash floods swept southern Thailand, cutting road and rail links, an interior ministry official said on Thursday.
The official told Reuters the floods were caused by heavy rain in the region, especially in the southern province of Prachuap Khiri Khan, that fell for about 24 hours beginning late on Tuesday.
Two bodies had been found so far and one boy was still missing, the official said, adding that the extent of the damage was still unknown.
Some areas of Kui Buri district in the province were under 2.5 metres (8.2 feet) of water, making it impossible for vehicles to pass, the official said.
The rains stopped late on Wednesday and authorities were assessing the damage, the official said.

About 100 people have been killed and 12 people injured nationwide since the monsoon season began in late May. The total cost of the flood damage was around 2.6 billion baht ($104 million)so far, the official said.
